title: Universal Resource Handle & Capability Contract

application_evidence.red_failure: client-typecheck before ARI-01 production contract existed

The application active-family selector moved from completed VTI to ARI without historical profile fanout.

No derivative lineage, archive ingestion, provider credentials/networking/scraping, hosted upload, migration, UI, tester distribution or release/deployment was authorized.
ARI-11 remains owner of the expanded rights/license/use-capability matrix.
